title: What a Phrase Carries --- Authority, a Story, a Silence, a Sense of Charm
label: ch:peso-cultural
canDo: I can name the cultural weight a Spanish phrase carries beyond its meaning, and tell a proverb from an idiom, an allusion from a word, and a euphemism from politeness.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C274-practice: name the weight each of the four phrases borrows, and say which one can be used correctly without knowing its source.
